Sensitivity Analysis API

This module implements global sensitivity analysis using PCE (Polynomial Chaos Expansion) surrogate methods and Sobol indices.

MORRIS = 'morris'

SensitivityAnalyzer

class uq.sensitivity.SensitivityAnalyzer(parameter_space, wrapper=None, samples=None, outputs=None)[source]

Bases: object

Performs global sensitivity analysis on vEcoli simulations.

This class supports multiple sensitivity analysis methods and can work with either a simulation wrapper (for running new simulations) or precomputed results.

__init__(parameter_space, wrapper=None, samples=None, outputs=None)[source]

Initialize the sensitivity analyzer.

Parameters:

  • parameter_space (InputParameterSpace) – Definition of the input parameter space

  • wrapper (SimulationWrapper | PrecomputedWrapper | None) – Optional simulation wrapper for running simulations

  • samples (ndarray | None) – Optional precomputed input samples of shape (n_samples, n_params)

  • outputs (ndarray | None) – Optional precomputed outputs of shape (n_samples, n_outputs)

analyze_with_pce(polynomial_order=3, n_samples=None, use_uqpy=True)[source]

Perform sensitivity analysis using PCE surrogate.

This is the recommended method from the UQ framework RFC.

Parameters:

  • polynomial_order (int) – Maximum polynomial order for PCE

  • n_samples (int | None) – Number of samples to use (if generating new samples)

  • use_uqpy (bool) – If True, use UQPy; otherwise use PyTUQ

Returns:

Tuple of (SobolIndices, PCESurrogate)

Return type:

tuple[SobolIndices, PCESurrogate]

analyze_with_sobol(n_samples=1024, calc_second_order=False)[source]

Perform Sobol sensitivity analysis via Monte Carlo sampling.

This method uses Saltelli’s sampling scheme for efficient computation of Sobol indices.

Parameters:

  • n_samples (int) – Number of base samples (total evaluations will be n_samples * (2 * n_params + 2))

  • calc_second_order (bool) – Whether to calculate second-order indices

Returns:

SobolIndices

Return type:

SobolIndices

Functions

run_sensitivity_analysis

uq.sensitivity.run_sensitivity_analysis(sim_data_path, output_dir, aggregation_strategy=AggregationStrategy.UNIFORM, polynomial_order=3, n_samples=None, include_vio=True, include_mecillinam=True, vio_expression_bounds=(0.0, 5.0), vio_trl_eff_bounds=(0.0, 2.0), mecillinam_conc_bounds=(0.0, 10.0), use_uqpy=True)[source]

Run a complete sensitivity analysis workflow.

This is a convenience function that sets up the parameter space, wrapper, and analyzer, then runs PCE-based sensitivity analysis.

Parameters:

  • sim_data_path (str) – Path to sim_data pickle file

  • output_dir (str) – Directory for outputs and cache

  • aggregation_strategy (AggregationStrategy) – Strategy for aggregating simulation outputs

  • polynomial_order (int) – PCE polynomial order

  • n_samples (int | None) – Number of samples (None for automatic)

  • include_vio (bool) – Include vio pathway parameters

  • include_mecillinam (bool) – Include mecillinam parameters

  • vio_expression_bounds (tuple[float, float]) – Bounds for vio expression

  • vio_trl_eff_bounds (tuple[float, float]) – Bounds for vio translation efficiency

  • mecillinam_conc_bounds (tuple[float, float]) – Bounds for mecillinam concentration

  • use_uqpy (bool) – Use UQPy (True) or PyTUQ (False)

Returns:

Tuple of (SobolIndices, PCESurrogate)

Return type:

tuple[SobolIndices, PCESurrogate]

Usage Examples

PCE-Based Analysis

from uq import SensitivityAnalyzer, InputParameterSpace

param_space = InputParameterSpace(include_vio=True, include_mecillinam=True)
analyzer = SensitivityAnalyzer(param_space, wrapper)

sobol, pce = analyzer.analyze_with_pce(
    polynomial_order=3,
    n_samples=100,
    use_uqpy=True,
)

# Get most influential parameters
for name, value in sobol.get_most_influential(n=5):
    print(f"{name}: {value:.4f}")

Direct Sobol Analysis

sobol = analyzer.analyze_with_sobol(
    n_samples=1024,
    calc_second_order=True,
)

print(f"First-order: {sobol.first_order}")
print(f"Total-order: {sobol.total_order}")
print(f"Second-order: {sobol.second_order}")

Convenience Functions

from uq import run_sensitivity_analysis, AggregationStrategy

sobol, pce = run_sensitivity_analysis(
    sim_data_path="./sim_data.cPickle",
    output_dir="./uq_analysis",
    aggregation_strategy=AggregationStrategy.UNIFORM,
    polynomial_order=3,
    include_vio=True,
    include_mecillinam=True,
)

Precomputed Results

from uq import analyze_precomputed_results

sobol, pce = analyze_precomputed_results(
    data_dir="./simulation_outputs",
    aggregation_strategy=AggregationStrategy.BY_GENERATION,
    polynomial_order=3,
)

Working with Results

# Access indices
print(f"Parameters: {sobol.parameter_names}")
print(f"First-order: {sobol.first_order}")
print(f"Total-order: {sobol.total_order}")

# Check for interactions
interactions = sobol.total_order - sobol.first_order
print(f"Interaction effects: {interactions}")

# Multi-output case
if sobol.first_order.ndim > 1:
    avg_s1 = np.mean(sobol.first_order, axis=0)
    print(f"Average first-order: {avg_s1}")
